text:
Yes, you can waive the hold by replying to the weather hold email. Before you do, a few things to know:

- **Cold or heat damage is no longer covered.** If you waive, the Plant Care Guarantee still applies, but not for cold or heat damage in transit. Damaged-on-arrival claims for cold or heat damage also won't be accepted.
- **I can't promise Friday delivery.** Holds can last up to 7 days, and after release, transit time depends on your zone and shipping method:
  - Standard: 2-3 business days (Zone 1), 3-5 (Zone 2), 5-8 (Zone 3)
  - Express: next business day (Zone 1), 2 business days (Zone 2), not available in Zone 3
- **Upgrading shipping:** the policy I have doesn't cover changing the shipping method on an order that's already placed, so I can't say whether that's possible.

If Friday is a firm deadline, I can escalate to a Support Lead to look at your order's timing. If you share your order number (LF- plus six digits), I can include it in the escalation.
